parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the client group used to access the data source.

parameters.name: ConnectionInfo
Credential
DataSourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data source.

parameters.name: DataSourceName
parameters.description: The name of the data source.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: A filter to specify which files to exclude. This parameter applies only to the archive feature.

parameters.name: Include
parameters.description: A filter to specify which files to include. This parameter applies only to the archive feature.

parameters.name: IndexLevel
parameters.description:
The index level for data source analysis. This parameter applies only to the archive feature.

- OFF: No index is created.

- META: A metadata index is created.

- ALL: A full-text index is created. (Deprecated)

parameters.name: Options
parameters.description: The options for data source analysis. This parameter applies only to the archive feature.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: A list of paths for data source analysis. This parameter applies only to the archive feature.

parameters.name: Schedule
parameters.description: The schedule for data source analysis. This parameter applies only to the archive feature. The format is `I|{startTime}|{interval}`. This specifies a task that starts at `{startTime}` and repeats at the specified `{interval}`. `startTime` is a Unix time value in seconds. `interval` is an ISO 8601 time interval. For example, `PT1H` indicates a one-hour interval, and `P1D` indicates a one-day interval.

parameters.name: SpeedLimit
parameters.description: The rate limiting configuration for data source analysis. This parameter applies only to the archive feature.
